notes: Sheet is rotated: north is to the left. Dane runs along the top edge, Knowlton down the left edge, Spring Grove Av. (80 ft) is the long diagonal on the right, Fergus runs along the bottom. Scale measured at about 5.94 px/ft from the scale bar. VANDALIA and C.H.&D. R.R. in the lower left are railroad labels, not streets. In the bottom-left corner Fergus continues west across the railroad to a street along the left paper edge (unlabelled here, Knowlton west of the railroad per the key map); the Fergus water pipe ends in an L at about (88, 7108) but the street's west face is off the sheet and the crossing centre may be off the sheet, so it is not recorded. DANE is also printed east of Mill Creek at the top right: Dane resumes there beyond the creek (recorded as an end, named Dane Street (south of Mill Creek) to keep it separate from the main Dane, which ends at Spring Grove). The 30 ft way east of Spring Grove at y about 4000 is unnamed. Dane centres are taken 33 ft (198 px) from the visible south block line; the Dane water pipe runs 10-20 px south of that.
